label: board
about: The Tasks board (the `board` component of oxplow-bundled's `tasks` page): `scope` is `thread`, `stream`, `me`, `pool` or `all` — the work assigned to the viewed thread, its stream's threads, the person, nobody, or anyone (`v_oxplow_task.assignee`); `thread_id` the viewed thread, which applies when `scope` is `thread`; a page's `stream_id` (implicit, as on every page) is the viewed stream, which applies when `scope` is `stream`. A view of the capability as a whole, so any extension may bring one: it reads `v_oxplow_task` and runs the task action points (`oxplow/task.move`, `task.edit`, … and bundled's `oxplow.tasks.assign`, `reorder`), whichever store answers. It shares the page's filters (`show`, `priority`, `q`, the tab's view): it draws them, as oxplow's board does, since the page has no rail.

label: list
about: The Task List's list (the `list` node of oxplow-bundled's `task-list` page): `scope` is `thread`, `stream`, `me`, `pool` or `all` — whom the items are assigned to (`v_oxplow_task.assignee`); `thread_id` the viewed thread, which applies when `scope` is `thread`. The page's filters and New Task… stay oxplow's.

label: description editor
about: A task's description editor (the `body` part of the `task` document): `uri` is the item. Its state, fields, About, links, comments, activity and mounts stay oxplow's.

label: state control
about: A task's state control (the `state` part of the `task` document; its Move To is never replaced, so an item can always move): `uri` is the item. The extension that fills the task model as the item's own store (its `provider`) replaces it: it shows that store's own states.

label: page body
about: A knowledge page's body (the `body` node of the `knowledge-page` page): `uri` is the page. Its About, referenced files, backlinks, comments and mounts stay oxplow's. The extension that fills the knowledge model as the page's own store (the URI's `store`) replaces it: oxwiki draws its pages' text as an editor, a store that keeps its pages read-only leaves oxplow's own read-only text.

label: history graph
about: The commit history's graph (`GitHistoryPage`, the Git dashboard): `head_sha` the stream's head, `reveal_sha` a commit to scroll to and mark (or null), `limit` how many commits. Its view is Git History's filters (`q`, `author`, `branch`; v2), which core's own list reads too. Core's own is a plain list; the graph is oxplow-bundled's component.
